text.title: Fitness-Function Suite Bootstrap — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the starter suite spec this methodology produces: 5 to 8 functions, at least one in each of performance, deployability, dependency, complexity and contract, each with tool, verbatim command, threshold, dated baseline, rollout mode, run stage, owner, and the category-specific fields the rules demand (endpoint and load profile, CI-derived minutes, dependency graph, baseline file, consumers or released schema); plus a promotion record for any blocking function and the four weekly reviews. Validator in scripts/validate-fitness-function-suite-bootstrap.py enforces it.

required.field: the service the suite guards, as named in the service catalogue
`layers[]` and `allowed_edges[]` written in the spec, not only in the tool config (r-ffsb-dependency-direction-tool)
the day the suite first runs in CI; weekly reviews are dated from it
exactly four review entries, each with `date`, `reviewed_by`, `red_functions[]`, `actions[]` (r-ffsb-owner-and-weekly-review)
monthly | quarterly — set at the fourth review

5 to 8 entries; every category present; per entry `id`, `category`, `tool`, `command`, `threshold` (operator, value, unit), `baseline` (value, measured_at), `mode`, `runs_on`, `owner`, `consecutive_red_reviews`; `promotion` when `mode` is blocking (r-ffsb-five-to-eight-functions, r-ffsb-ratchet-first-then-block)

forbidden.pattern: fewer than 5 or more than 8 functions — fm-oversized-launch
any of performance, deployability, dependency, complexity, contract with zero functions — fm-category-gap
a performance function with `runs_on: pull_request`, or with `runner_kind` other than dedicated-runner / dedicated-environment, or without a versioned `load_profile` — fm-perf-on-shared-runner
`mode: blocking` without a `promotion` record of at least 5 green runs on main, an approver and a review date — fm-blocking-on-day-one
a complexity function without a committed `baseline_file` — fm-complexity-without-baseline
a contract function that names neither `consumers[]` (Pact) nor `released_schema_ref` (schema diff) — fm-contract-provider-side-only
a deployability function whose `threshold.unit` is not minutes or that has no committed `script_path` — r-ffsb-deploy-lead-time-from-ci
fewer than four `weekly_reviews`, or `consecutive_red_reviews` of 2 or more with no `action` — fm-no-weekly-review

list.item: 5 to 8 functions and every one of the five categories present (r-ffsb-five-to-eight-functions).
The performance function names one endpoint, a versioned load profile and a dedicated runner, and runs post-merge or nightly (r-ffsb-perf-p95-under-fixed-load).
The deployability function has a threshold in minutes computed by a committed script (r-ffsb-deploy-lead-time-from-ci).
The dependency function uses ArchUnit / NetArchTest / dependency-cruiser / import-linter on every pull request and the graph is written in `dependency_graph` (r-ffsb-dependency-direction-tool).
The complexity function has a per-function limit and a committed baseline file (r-ffsb-complexity-ratchet-with-baseline).
The contract function names its consumers or the released schema it diffs against (r-ffsb-contract-breaking-change-gate).
Every `mode: blocking` function carries a promotion record with at least five green runs on main, an approver and a review date (r-ffsb-ratchet-first-then-block).
Four weekly reviews are dated from launch, every function has an owner, and any function at two consecutive reds carries an action (r-ffsb-owner-and-weekly-review).
